results.title: Nikolái
results.overview: Damián and Adela live on a remote farm under their father's rule. When he leaves, a boy named Nikolai arrives, sparking friendship and city dreams. But as summer ends, Damián plans his escape, leaving Adela facing a uncertain future

results.title: Sam Wants Her Sweater Back
results.overview: Three queer friends launch a half-witted heist to steal back a sweater from one of their exes. But recovering from heartbreak isn't quite the slick-lit, neon-noir adventure one of them imagines.

results.title: No Survivors
results.overview: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, it follows a young man seeking revenge against the "White Tiger" bandits who destroyed his family.

results.title: A Separation
results.overview: Grieving the loss of his father and reeling from a divorce, a man returns home in search of his roots, but finds only fragile connections and a longed-for solitude that brings him back to square one.

results.title: Vacío Luminoso
results.overview: Filmmaker Oliver Laxe leads his crew and a group of ravers deep into the desert to shoot his feature, Sirāt. Within the confines of his hotel room in Morocco, something unspoken lingers in his chest as Laxe opens up for a recorded conversation. As filming intensifies in the barren landscape, the film begins to inhabit those who take part.

results.title: Pitt Siyapa
results.overview: Nimmi, a clever young woman, transforms her father's death into an unusual business running virtual funerals for NRIs. With her ragtag crew, she orchestrates chaotic send-offs until NRI Mickey arrives, sparking hilarious chaos and romance.

results.title: Melody of the Damned
results.overview: Two siblings accidentally summon a group of musical demons who take over their late grandmother's attic to put on a variety show.

results.title: Aldir Blanc - Response to Time
results.overview: Dorival Caymmi’s definition of Aldir Blanc is unequivocal: “Aldir Blanc is a jeweler of words.” Treating everyday language as gold, Aldir created a universe of his own, capturing like no one else the everyday life of Rio de Janeiro and Brazil through songs, poems, and chronicles.  More than a film about the artist’s life or body of work, this is an immersion into his universe—his inspirations, his personal geography, and his singular way of telling stories. An adventure through the musical and literary labyrinths of one of the most intriguing minds in contemporary Brazilian culture.

results.title: Is Your Smartphone Spying On You?
results.original_title: Is Your Smartphone Spying On You?
results.overview: Alexis Conran explores the claims that smartphones and tech companies might be listening in on users and collecting a vast amount of personal data. How do our phones seem to know everything?

results.title: The Lights, They Fall
results.overview: Sixteen-year-old Ilay drifts through the summer on the outskirts of Berlin while a palliative nurse accompanies his ailing mother during her last days.

results.title: Songs to Die In Havana
results.original_title: Canciones Para Morir en La Habana
results.overview: A nocturnal portrait of Havana and its inhabitants through the songs they listen to and sing.

results.title: On a String
results.overview: A young, Juilliard-trained violist is still living at home with her parents in the heart of NYC, while trying to make a living playing gigs with her friends in the homes of strangers.

results.title: The Frontier Under The Blood Moon
results.overview: The werewolf shaman from Sumo Mohe tribe ambushes the Buddhist maiden presented by Silla to the Tang Dynasty, attempting to sabotage their efforts to build friendly relations, only to run into the detective Di Renjie, who is handling a case at the border. Di joins forces with Sima Xiaodao and Doctor Duan to unravel the tribe's conspiracy, saving the nation from danger once again.

results.title: The Newcomers
results.overview: Three tweens investigate what is poisoning their village's rivers. Mateo narrates as he, his brother Tomas, refugee Tiana, and her dog Nube embark on an adventure to uncover the source of pollution.

results.title: The Bone Bandits
results.overview: When two bandits break into a paleontology museum to steal a priceless fossil, they are unexpectedly aided by an overly dedicated historical re-enactor who mistakes them for museum employees.

results.title: GW:s mord – Taximordet i Hjälstaviken
results.overview: A 26-year-old taxi driver drives towards the Hjälstaviken nature reserve and never comes home. A week later, the police make a macabre discovery: he is found dead, hanging from a tree. Suspicions are directed at five young people who were in the area. A 15-year-old girl had previously reported him for rape. Leif GW Persson examines the case and the legal proceedings.

results.title: Little Dove
results.overview: December 24th. After a fight with her mother, 14-year-old Mila runs around searching for her sister, who works as a bicycle courier and hasn't come home. During her search, Mila meets courier Andre, 26, and accompanies him, speeding through Berlin on his bicycle rack, in his demanding job. They briefly form a surrogate family. Will any of them spend Christmas Eve at home?

results.title: Sgt. Frog
results.original_title: 新劇場版☆ケロロ軍曹 復活して速攻地球滅亡の危機であります！
results.overview: New Sgt. Frog movie to celebrate the series' 20th anniversary.

results.title: The Quiet Hour
results.overview: On a winter afternoon, with a storm about to break, Dani follows her cousins ​​Nora and Inés to a cube-shaped shelter in the middle of the woods. There, they perform a ritual to hold back the rain and save their friend—"the Presence." Dani must follow a set of rules for the ritual to succeed, but the moment Nora sacrifices an earthworm, she can no longer bear it and breaks the cardinal rule: never leave the cube.
